messages:
maria: quick sync from today's alpha run. two small but recurring items: token counter clarity and stop/regenerate placement on compact widths. posting notes.
kevin: can you describe the issue briefly? screenshots help but a short repro is fine.
maria: on 1024px the token meter's padding overlaps the stop icon by a few pixels. users try to hit stop and hit the meter. also the hover details currently only show 'tokens' with no breakdown.
sam: dev note: hovercard rendering causes a tiny layout shift because we switch from inline to absolute on hover. quick fix: render in portal and reserve the action slot so the stop button never moves. also add pointer-events:none on decorative parts of the meter.
ali: UX suggestion: keep Stop as an always-visible primary control (44px target). move Regenerate into the kebab menu to reduce clutter. for the hovercard, show a compact breakdown: "Prompt: 52 32 context  Session: 884 (est)" with an export icon to save to Prompt Library.
olga: accessibility nits: hover-only content must be keyboard-focusable and screen reader friendly. add role="status" and aria-live="polite" for streaming token updates. ensure reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
kevin: microcopy: change label from "Stop generation" to "Stop output" (shorter). hover header: "Estimated tokens (approx.)". also add Esc hotkey to stop when chat pane focused.
maria: plan: kevin mock for collapsed/hover/focus/mobile states, sam prototype portal + reserved slot, ali draft export UX copy, olga do a keyboard/a11y pass. quick 3-user usability test next week.
sam: i'll try a perf run with 512 token streams after prototyping; avoiding reflow should help frame rates.
kevin: i'll drop mocks by EOD.
maria: thanks all.
